system.description:
Make three Quick attacks. Each has a different effect on a hit. These attacks can target the same or separate creatures.

  • First Attack, Weaken: Your attack deals base damage equal to [2 x Soul].
  • Second Attack, Overwhelm: Your attack Staggers the enemy.
  • Final Attack, Annihilate: Your attack inflicts 5 stacks of Bleeding Wounds and benefits from Backstab.

You may not activate any other Skills until this Ultimate is resolved.
